scaled_small_mapf.description: Scaled MAPF reproduction of the central Fig. 2 claim: bounded real-time planning should retain full-horizon success under tiny per-iteration planning budgets, while naive restart replanning can fail.
scaled_small_mapf.notes: The paper reports this result graphically and qualitatively rather than as an exact table. These values are scaled reproduction targets from the packaged deterministic benchmark; the paper's qualitative target is success parity between bounded real-time planning and full-horizon planning, with restart replanning failing on congested cases.

success_rate.description: Fraction of expected slice instances solved with legal paths that end at the goals.

valid_rate.description: Fraction of expected slice instances with collision-free, legal joint paths.

coverage_rate.description: Fraction of expected slice instances represented by an artifact result, penalizing selective omission of hard cases.

mean_normalized_cost.description: Mean per-instance path cost divided by the independent-agent shortest-path lower bound; failed, invalid, or omitted instances receive a deterministic instance-size penalty.

mean_expansions.description: Hardware-independent search effort reported as node expansions per represented slice instance.

duplicate_results.description: Number of duplicate result rows for expected slice instances, catching artifact padding or cherry-picking.

instances.description: Number of expected instances in this evaluation slice; included for auditability, not ranking.

scaled_small_mapf_budget3.description: Additional scaled MAPF reproduction at a larger real-time per-iteration expansion budget, testing that success parity with full-horizon planning holds beyond the minimum setting.
scaled_small_mapf_budget3.notes: The paper varies millisecond cutoffs in Figure 2. This gym uses hardware-independent expansion budgets, so these values are scaled reproduction targets rather than exact paper plot readings.

movingai_random32_4agent.description: MovingAI MAPF benchmark subset on random-32-32-20 random scenarios with 4 agents, matching the paper's standard-benchmark setting at reduced agent count. Bounded real-time planning should match full-horizon success while naive restart replanning can fail.
movingai_random32_4agent.notes: The paper uses larger standard benchmark slices with 25 scenes per map. This gym uses a verified public MovingAI subset at reduced agent count to keep evaluation lightweight; values are scaled reproduction targets documenting the same qualitative comparison.
